I would like to begin this session in the context of God's desire to build a kingdom society on earth. And I remind you that God’s original goal for humanity was to expand the scope of His heavenly kingdom to include the earth. A very simple and practical plan.

Secondly, his original vision was to colonize the earth with the Kingdom of Heaven so that the culture of Heaven would be transferred to the earth. It's a very simple idea, one that most of us in this region understand. Third, God's original goal was to create a community of heavenly citizens on Earth. This is the ultimate goal of colonialism. The goal of colonialism is to transfer its culture, values, standards, and way of life to a distant land. That was, and still is, God's plan.

He wanted his invisible country to be transferred to Earth, which is visible. Therefore, God’s purpose can be summarized in a statement he made to Moses. I want to read it with you. Genesis, Chapter 28. Let's go there. Some of your Gospels do not contain an accurate translation of this verse. But in Hebrew, it is written like this. Genesis 28:3 says: “The Almighty God blesses you.” how? By making you fruitful. how? By increasing your numbers. Why? Not to take you to heaven, but to make you a community of people.

The nation is the people. The country is the land. The nation is the people. You can have a great country with bad people.
